preview: Customer-related data is naturally fragmented across different operational contexts. In modern organizations, such fragmentation can appear through campaign-response datasets, digital behavioral traces, session-level intent indicators, and commercial transaction histories. In this sense, the project integrates ingestion, distributed storage, distributed processing, lakehouse management, analytical querying, transformation governance, validation, orchestration, monitoring, and baseline

title: Main Objectives of the Project
preview: The project pursues a set of complementary objectives. First, it aims to organize heterogeneous customer-oriented datasets in a reproducible way. Second, it aims to transport these datasets through Kafka-based ingestion flows in order to create explicit and replayable movement patterns. Third, it aims to persist raw data in an HDFS bronze layer before converting it into structured analytical tables through Spark and
preview2: Iceberg.
